suspicion: critical bonus (op 15) and raw 163 applied in the wrong order for some damage family
why_rejected: Direct Melee/Ranged: bonus then school; Magic/None and periodic: school then bonus; non-damage: bonus only. Reproduces Trinity melee path (Unit.cpp:1216-1231), SpellCriticalDamageBonus (7279-7306, also used by periodic ticks SpellAuraEffects.cpp:5707,5791) and SpellCriticalHealingBonus (7309-7325). core_test selected_martial_expert.rs:80-94.

suspicion: passive raw-163 terms bypass exclusive-group arbitration
why_rejected: Passive raw-163 activation always compiles group 0 (no composition on the passive wire shape), so no passive term can belong to a group.

suspicion: white main-hand crit ignores the actor multiplier, raw 163 and op-15
why_rejected: White admission requires critical_strikes empty and an isolated program with no raw-163 definitions; Heart's op-15 mask covers only Crusader Strike family payloads (not auto attack), matching Trinity where spellmods need a SpellInfo. White crit x2 therefore matches every admitted configuration.

suspicion: raw-638 read from the defender while Trinity reads it from the attacker
why_rejected: Trinity multiplies by the attacker's MOD_CRITICAL_BLOCK_AMOUNT (Unit.cpp:1243,1463) although the only carrier (Martial Expert 429638, a warrior talent that blocks) describes the holder's own critical blocks; Core's defender ownership is the semantic reading and Trinity is the outlier.

suspicion: HybridMax adds target-held raw 197 / raw 183 to both channels and so double counts
why_rejected: Adding the same x to both channels before max equals adding x to the max (max(a+x,b+x) = max(a,b)+x); matches Trinity's single post-max addition.

suspicion: selected raw-290/308/334 compile authored points (raw-638 class)
why_rejected: selected_percent_points returns the selected amount; probe with a two-rank Set curve proves +4 (rank 2) is consumed.

suspicion: crit chance clamped before modifiers (overcap baseline lost)
why_rejected: Baseline retained unclamped (critical.rs:71-75); floor 0 after modifiers, clamp to 1 only in resolve_critical.

suspicion: fallible crit calculation after the crit draw
why_rejected: All crit arithmetic (chance modifiers, raw 163, op 15) runs inside prepare_impact_critical at quote; commit only draws and selects precomputed normal/critical amounts.

suspicion: periodic ticks snapshot or ignore live crit chance
why_rejected: PeriodicCriticalPolicy::SourceActorAtOccurrence recomputes crit from the source actor at every tick (planning.rs:852-858) and requires SPELL_ATTR8 PeriodicCanCrit (program/periodic.rs:1518-1541); Trinity evaluates GetCritChanceFor at each tick (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:1278-1281, 5705) gated by CanPeriodicTickCrit (6132-6135); simc adds STATE_CRIT to update_flags (action.cpp:2729, 2787).
